name: Convert Images to WebP on Upload
author: Daniel Esparza

sections.description:
Convert Images to WebP on Upload converts JPG and PNG images to WebP at the moment they are uploaded. It uses Imagick when available, or GD as a fallback. Simple settings let you enable or disable the conversion and set the WebP quality.

GIF images are not converted, so animated GIFs keep their animation.

Video
sections.installation:
1. Upload the convert-images-webp-upload folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Convert to WebP in the admin menu to set the quality.
sections.faq:
Is the original image deleted?

Yes. The uploaded JPG or PNG is replaced by its WebP version before WordPress stores it, so only the .webp file is kept.

What does the server need?

Imagick, or GD with imagewebp support. If neither is available, images are uploaded without conversion.

Are GIF images converted?

No. GIF images are uploaded unchanged.
